config.title: OpenCode Chat
config.cliPath.description: Path to the OpenCode binary. Leave empty to search the PATH.
config.terminalCwd.description: Working directory of the terminal. Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ~.
config.focusOnLaunch.description: Focus the section when OpenCode is launched.
config.disposeOnExit.description: Remove the terminal session when OpenCode exits.
config.chainExit.description: Run `exit` after OpenCode so the session closes cleanly when it ends.
config.autoLaunch.description: Start OpenCode automatically when the section opens, and relaunch it when a session ends. Turning this off leaves the section idle until you run OpenCode: Launch.
config.tuiTabs.description: Session tab strip of the OpenCode TUI (the bar showing the session title and '+ New session'). Applied to THIS section's terminal only, through OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT; your global ~/.config/opencode/cli.json is never modified. `off` hides it, `auto` shows it when there is room, `on` forces it.
config.useConptyDll.description: Use the conpty.dll bundled with node-pty instead of the system one. This is the path VS Code's own terminal uses on Windows, and it avoids the system ConPTY hangs.
config.ptySpawnTimeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for node-pty to confirm the spawn before treating the PTY as blocked.
config.autoPromptInstall.description: If `opencode` is not found on the PATH, offer to install it. The section opens either way — the helper is a convenience, not a gate.
config.installMethod.description: How to install OpenCode. `npm` runs `npm install -g @opencode/cli` (the current v2 package; `opencode-ai` is frozen at v1). `script` runs `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash` (POSIX only; on Windows it falls back to npm). `auto` means npm.
config.usageEnabled.description: Show the model usage indicator in the status bar. It reuses the credential the OpenCode CLI already has stored, read with `opencode auth export`, so no setup is needed; only if the CLI has none does it fall back to the key set with OpenCode: Set Usage API Key. With neither available it does not appear and sends no request at all. The OpenCode TUI itself stays a plain PTY and never goes through this code path.
config.usageInterval.description: Minutes between usage refreshes. Values under 5 are raised to 5.
